description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Panthers WR Jalen Coker (ankle) is officially active for Week 3.
items.impact: Coker was considered questionable after suffering an ankle injury in Week 2. With Xavier Legette inactive, Coker and Tetairoa McMillan should see plenty of targets against Cleveland.
items.title: Jalen Coker (ankle) officially active for Week 3

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Jaylen Wright (stinger/foot) is inactive for Week 3 for the Miami Dolphins against the Kansas City Chiefs.
items.impact: Wright will sit out after being unable to make enough progress throughout the week to suit up, as Ollie Gordon II will see increased touches behind No. 1 running back De'Von Achane against a stout Chiefs defense Sunday.
items.title: Jaylen Wright (stinger/foot) inactive for Week 3

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Panthers WR Xavier Legette (knee) is officially inactive for a Week 3 matchup with the Browns.
items.impact: Legette was a late add to the Panthers' injury report on Thursday and was limited on Friday. Brycen Tremayne and John Metchie will see increased playing time behind Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker.
items.title: Xavier Legette (knee) officially inactive for Week 3

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Steelers DB Joey Porter Jr. (back) is officially inactive for a Week 3 matchup with the Bengals.
items.impact: Porter was listed as questionable to play and will now have to wait at least one more week to make his season debut. This is a big boost for the Bengals' offense as the Steelers will be without a key piece of their secondary.
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (back) officially inactive for Week 3

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Christian Mahogany (hip) is active for Week 3 for the Detroit Lions against the New York Jets.
items.impact: Mahogany will take the field after being sidelined in Week 2 for head coach Dan Campbell, joining rookie Blake Miller (knee) in returning to a Detroit offensive line that will look to keep quarterback Jared Goff clean against the Jets Sunday.
items.title: Christian Mahogany (hip) active for Week 3

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Blake Miller (knee) is active for Week 3 for the Detroit Lions against the New York Jets.
items.impact: Miller is good to go after progressing throughout the practice week, boosting a Detroit offensive line that will look to keep quarterback Jared Goff upright against the Jets defense Sunday.
items.title: Blake Miller (knee) active for Week 3

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren (shoulder) is officially active for a Week 3 matchup with the Bengals.
items.impact: Warren was limited in practice throughout the week but will play and start against the Bengals. With Rico Dowdle (toe) inactive, Warren could be in line for a workhorse role in Week 3.
items.title: Jaylen Warren (shoulder) officially active for Week 3

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Browns DB Tyson Campbell (ankle/hip) is officially inactive for a Week 3 matchup with Carolina.
items.impact: Campbell was considered as questionable this week, but was dealing with multiple injuries and will not be available against the Panthers. Noah Igbinoghene and Mekhi Blackmon should see additional playing time with Campbell out.
items.title: Tyson Campbell (ankle/hip) officially inactive for Week 3

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Ed Oliver (hip) is active for Week 3 for the Buffalo Bills against the Los Angeles Chargers according to Cameron Wolfe.
items.impact: Oliver takes the field after clearing through pregame activities without any setbacks, boosting a Buffalo front seven that will look to disrupt a Chargers offense still looking for some consistency entering the Week 3 contest.
items.title: Ed Oliver (hip) active for Week 3

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Giants RB Devin Singletary is officially inactive for a Week 3 matchup with the Titans.
items.impact: Singletary is a healthy inactive for the Giants after averaging just 2.8 yards per carry in the first two games. Najee Harris will serve as the primary backup to Cam Skattebo.
items.title: Devin Singletary officially inactive for Week 3

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Keon Coleman (ankle) is active for Week 3 for the Buffalo Bills against the Los Angeles Chargers according to Cameron Wolfe.
items.impact: Coleman will suit up after passing through pregame activities without any issues, joining fellow wideout DJ Moore (shoulder) in returning to a Buffalo passing attack that will look to make some noise against the Chargers Sunday.
items.title: Keon Coleman (ankle) active for Week 3

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Jets WR Adonai Mitchell (finger) is officially inactive for Week 3.
items.impact: Mitchell was listed as questionable to play against the Lions after suffering the injury in practice Thursday. Isaiah Williams will likely see an increased role with Mitchell sidelined.
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (finger) officially inactive for Week 3

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: DJ Moore (shoulder) is officially active for Week 3 for the Buffalo Bills against the Los Angeles Chargers according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: Moore is good to go after not battling any setbacks during pregame activities, boosting a Buffalo passing attack that will look to push the envelope against the Chargers Sunday.
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) active for Week 3

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Patriots TE Eli Raridon (thigh) is officially inactive for a Week 3 matchup with the Jaguars.
items.impact: Raridon injured his thigh in Week 2 and was considered questionable to play Sunday. With Raridon out, Hunter Henry should see even more playing time against Jacksonville.
items.title: Eli Raridon (thigh) officially inactive for Week 3

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Titans RB Tyjae Spears (ankle) is officially active for a Week 3 matchup with the Giants.
items.impact: Spears was listed as questionable to play Sunday, but was able to return and practice Friday. He should be expected to split time with Tony Pollard against the Giants.
items.title: Tyjae Spears (ankle) officially active for Week 3

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Giants DE Brian Burns (ankle) is officially active for a Week 3 matchup with the Titans.
items.impact: Burns did not practice at all this week after suffering a sprained ankle Monday night against the Rams. His ability to play against Tennessee will provide the Giants' defense with a big boost in their pass rush.
items.title: Brian Burns (ankle) officially active for Week 3

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Brock Bowers (knee) is expected to play on Sunday against the Saints barring a surprise setback.
items.impact: Bowers has been out for the first two weeks of the season after undergoing a meniscus trim surgery, but it looks like he will be back for Sunday. Start him in all formats, but temper expectations as he could start off a little slow.
items.title: Brock Bowers (knee) expected to play on Sunday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) is expected to play on Sunday against the Bengals after being considered questionable with a foot injury.
items.impact: Pittman should give Aaron Rodgers a reliable possession receiver over the middle of the field, opening things up for the offense. Germie Bernard tried to play that role last week, but didn't quite have the same fluidity as Pittman. He should be a decent WR3 with upside.
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) expected to play on Sunday against Cincy

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers signed G Laken Tomlinson.
items.impact: Tomlinson will add depth to a banged up Packers offensive line.
items.title: Laken Tomlinson signs with Packers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cowboys placed S P.J. Locke on injured reserve.
items.impact: Locke will miss at least the next four games.
items.title: P.J. Locke (foot) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Caleb Williams has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Eagles.
items.impact: Williams was never expected to play this week after going down with his injury last week. It will be Tyson Bagent or Case Keenum starting on Monday.
items.title: Caleb Williams (hamstring) ruled out Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Broncos placed RB Jonah Coleman on injured reserve.
items.impact: Coleman had already been ruled out for this week's game. He will now miss at least the next four games. J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey will continue to lead the Broncos backfield.
items.title: Jonah Coleman (ankle) placed on IR

title: Fantasy Player News
